books.title: Rapture
books.subtitle: The Fractured Sky
books.author: Aether Vale
books.description: When the sky fractures and dragons fall, an ordinary omega named Cassian Reed survives among strangers who will become family, founders, and rivals—while the slow bond between him and alpha Adrian Hale grows across catastrophe, rebuilding, and choice.

books.title: Echoes of the Void
books.subtitle: The Omega Who Became the End
books.author: Aether Vale
books.description: An average, unloved transmigrator reborn as an unwanted spare omega tries again and again across secret time loops to find peace and love—until exhaustion and betrayal transform him into the absolute End of everything.

books.title: The Hollow Canopy
books.subtitle: What the Rain Kept
books.author: Aether Vale
books.description: Fourteen years after St. Briony, Major Calder Rhys is ordered to keep a classified omega scientist alive in an unmapped rainforest. Dr. Ivo Maren recognizes him at once and says nothing. Beneath the canopy, a dead civilization is still trying to finish the question that ended it.
